_comment: Oracle dump of UnitLookup.find over every 1-3 character candidate (ASCII letters, µ μ Ω Ω ° ℃) plus ~70 longer spellings; only known symbols are listed, `unknownCount` counts the rest (every unlisted candidate must be unknown in Rust). factor/offset are exact rationals to the system unit, piPower is the exponent of π folded into the factor. prefix is the longest prefix with prefix(rest) == unit, null for atoms. symjaFactor/symjaOffset are UnitConversions.between's Symja printout, as a cross-check.
